learning_outcomes.text: Draws and dimensions the views of a part whose perspective drawing is known.
Draws the third view and perspective of a part for which two views are known.
Draws the section view of a part.
Effectively uses a computer in drawing.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to technical drawing, general issues related to the course, drawing tools and equipment, drawing papers, line types, scale, perspective drawings.
Technical drawing rules, basic and auxiliary view drawings (projections).
Deriving views of a machine part whose perspective drawing is known.
Deriving the third view of a machine part for which two views are known.
Sectioning rules, full section, half section, revolved section, partial section, stepped section, profile section.
Computer drawing applications: Preparing template files, Draw&Modify commands.
Computer drawing applications: Perspective drawing applications.
Computer drawing applications: View drawing applications.
Computer drawing applications: Section view drawing applications.
Computer drawing applications: Solid model drawing applications.
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated from term studies (midterm exam and quiz) and the final exam. Term studies contribute 50% to the overall success, with the midterm exam accounting for 75% and the quiz for 25%. The final exam contributes 50% to the overall success.
bibliography: Kaptı, A.O., (2022). Bilgisayar Destekli Teknik Resim, ISBN: 978-625-427-374-2, Nobel Yayınları, Ankara.
